player_prompt.intro:
Yɛrɛ kɛɛ Player {player_id} o zugɛ la Indian Poker.
- Kɛɛ kɔɔnɔ 52; yɛrɛ wɛɛ o kɛɛ kɔɔnɔ o zugɛ la.
- Kɛɛ kɔɔlɛ {ante} o zugɛ la, {max_rounds} zugɛ la.
- Zugɛ wɛɛ zugɛ: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X yɛrɛ kɛɛ zugɛ la wɛɛ o zugɛ la.)
- Kɛɛ kɔɔnɔ sɔɔ zugɛ la wɛɛ kɛɛ kɔɔnɔ o zugɛ la.
